product.title: Private Car Tour to Mt. Fuji Lake Kawaguchiko or Hakone

description.text: In Tokyo, this private 10-to-11-hour chartered car keeps one group with a guide and driver for either Mount Fuji and Lake Kawaguchiko or Hakone and Lake Ashi. Hotel pickup and an air-conditioned minivan are listed so the day stays on lake viewpoints, shrine approaches, or ropeway windows rather than a mixed coach itinerary. Entrance fees for hot springs or museums remain separate. The published choice is one axis, not a combined Fuji-and-Hakone cram. The format suits visitors who want a private scenic day without renting a highway car. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Tokyo, and the itinerary stays on Mount Fuji, Lake Kawaguchiko, Hakone, and Lake Ashi that shape this charter rather than a Kamakura coastal add-on.

highlights: Choose the Mount Fuji and Kawaguchiko or Hakone and Lake Ashi option
